film_id.name: film_id
film_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each film record.

description.name: description
description.meaning: A brief summary or synopsis of the film's plot.

release_year.name: release_year
release_year.meaning: The year the film was released.

language_id.name: language_id
language_id.meaning: Foreign key referencing the primary language of the film.

original_language_id.name: original_language_id
original_language_id.meaning: Foreign key referencing the original language of the film, if different from the primary language.

rental_duration.name: rental_duration
rental_duration.meaning: The number of days a customer can rent the film.

rental_rate.name: rental_rate
rental_rate.meaning: The daily rental price for the film.

length.name: length
length.meaning: The duration of the film in minutes.

replacement_cost.name: replacement_cost
replacement_cost.meaning: The cost to replace the film if lost or damaged.

rating.name: rating
rating.meaning: The age-appropriate rating assigned to the film.

special_features.name: special_features
special_features.meaning: List of special features included with the film (e.g., deleted scenes, trailers).

last_update.name: last_update
last_update.meaning: Timestamp indicating when the film record was last modified.

table.name: d_cre_Docs_and_Epenses__ref_document_types
table.summary: A reference table defining standard document types with their codes, names, and quality descriptions.

document_type_code.name: document_type_code
document_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a specific document type.

document_type_name.name: document_type_name
document_type_name.meaning: The human-readable name of the document type.

document_type_description.name: document_type_description
document_type_description.meaning: A qualitative assessment or description associated with the document type, seemingly indicating quality or sentiment.

table.name: d_cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups__order_items
table.summary: Stores the line-level details of orders, linking specific products to orders with their respective quantities.

order_item_id.name: order_item_id
order_item_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a specific line item within an order.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.meaning: Reference to the parent order containing this item.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.meaning: Reference to the specific product included in this order line.

order_quantity.name: order_quantity
order_quantity.meaning: The number of units of the product ordered in this specific line item.

other_item_details.name: other_item_details
other_item_details.meaning: Optional additional information or notes regarding the specific item line.

table.name: d_store_1__genres
table.summary: A reference table defining music genres with unique identifiers and descriptive names.

id.name: id
id.meaning: Unique identifier for each genre record.

name.name: name
name.meaning: The descriptive name of the music genre.
